name: flow-agent
description: Claude Code and Codex in the native chat, over the Agent Client Protocol, using each repo's own harness.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Agents run commands in your workspace, so none can be started until you trust this folder.

chatSessions.name: claude
chatSessions.description: Claude Code with this repo's CLAUDE.md, hooks and skills
chatSessions.welcomeMessage: Runs your local Claude Code with this repo's harness: CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills, MCP.

chatSessions.name: codex
chatSessions.description: OpenAI Codex CLI with this repo's AGENTS.md
chatSessions.welcomeMessage: Runs your local Codex CLI with this repo's AGENTS.md. Sign in once with `codex login`.

colors.description: Manual mode: asks before every change.

flow.agents.showChat.description: Also offer Claude and Codex in the chat panel. Off by default: agents run in terminals and the Agents dock shows their status.

flow.agents.custom.description: Your own agent commands, offered in Start an Agent. User settings only: a repository's .vscode/settings.json cannot add commands that run in your terminal.

command.description: Run in a new terminal in the workspace folder.

flow.agents.mcp.markdownDescription: Give agents started from Axle the `axle` tools (open files, the git diff and flows in the editor, find entry points, symbols, definitions and references, read diagnostics and flows as text, draw diagrams and plans). They are added to the agent with `--mcp-config`, next to your own MCP servers; they cannot write files or run commands. Takes effect for agents started afterwards.

flow.agents.shim.markdownDescription: Also give a `claude` you type by hand in an Axle terminal the `axle` tools (open the diff, show flows, find symbols, diagnostics). Axle puts a small `claude` script first on the PATH of its own terminals; it runs the real `claude` with `--mcp-config` added, and passes subcommands such as `claude mcp` through untouched. Requires `#flow.agents.mcp#`. Takes effect after reloading the window.

flow.agents.planBoard.description: When an agent proposes a plan (leaves plan mode), draw it as a board in Axle and tick its steps as the agent edits the files they point at.

flow.agents.turnImpact.description: When an agent finishes a turn, show on its row which flows (endpoints) the files it edited may affect.

flow.agents.notify.approval.description: Notify when an agent waits for your approval (a permission or a plan) while you look elsewhere: another window, or another terminal.

flow.agents.notify.question.description: Notify when an agent asks you a question while you look elsewhere.

flow.agents.notify.error.description: Notify when an agent hits an error (an API error, a run of failing tool calls, a crash) while you look elsewhere.

flow.agents.notify.done.description: Notify when an agent finishes a turn while you look elsewhere.

flow.agents.notify.quiet.description: Quiet mode: no agent notifications at all. The Agents dock still ranks and marks what needs you.

flow.agents.codexHooks.description: Show Codex's status (working, needs you, done) and its edits on the canvas. Axle writes read-only hooks to its own Codex profile ($CODEX_HOME/axle.config.toml) and starts Codex with `-p axle`; your config.toml is not changed. Codex asks you once to trust these hooks (/hooks).
